items.q: Is this different from asking ChatGPT directly?
items.a: Yes, fundamentally. Asking ChatGPT 'is my website well optimized?' gives a generic opinion based on what it knows about your URL — often approximate and non-reproducible. Detekia analyzes the actual DOM of your page: HTML structure, schema.org, metadata, links, content. The result is a quantified score out of 100, 8 objectively measured criteria, and recommendations prioritized by impact. It's the difference between an opinion and a diagnosis.

items.q: What is GEO and how is it different from SEO?
items.a: GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) is the practice of optimizing your website to appear in AI-generated responses — ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity. Unlike SEO which aims to rank on Google, GEO aims to be cited and recommended directly in AI answers. The criteria are different: AI models value clarity, citability, credibility and structured data.

items.q: How does the Detekia analysis work?
items.a: Enter your website URL, and Detekia scrapes your content and analyzes it against 8 GEO criteria: extractability, verifiability, E-E-A-T authority, AI crawlability, structured data, editorial neutrality, external presence and freshness. Our AI then generates personalized expert recommendations for your website. The full methodology is available on our Methodology page.

items.q: Why is the analysis really free?
items.a: The basic analysis — score out of 100, 8 detailed criteria, one expert recommendation preview — is completely free with no signup required. No credit card needed. We believe everyone should be able to know if their website is visible to AI. The full report with all detailed recommendations and action plans is available for 29 €, one-time payment.

On Detekia, a score above 70/100 is considered good. Between 45 and 70, your website has solid foundations but needs targeted optimizations. Below 45, priority actions are needed. Most analyzed websites score between 15 and 45 — even major brands often score low because their websites are optimized to sell, not to be cited by AI.

No. Detekia analyzes your website in real time and doesn't store any of your website data beyond 24 hours. Analysis results are cached for 24 hours to speed up successive analyses of the same website, but no personal data is stored.

items.q: Does Detekia work for all types of websites?
items.a: Yes — e-commerce, blogs, SaaS, business websites, portfolios, institutional sites. GEO criteria are universal. Some types of websites do have a natural advantage: blogs with rich editorial content, websites with strong press coverage, and platforms that publish original data. But all websites can improve significantly with the right optimizations.
